subjective.content: 41-year-old male software engineer presenting with 12 weeks of mood and concentration difficulties, onset coinciding with a workplace reorganization. Reports difficulty falling asleep progressing to early morning awakening (3:30–4:00 AM), pervasive fatigue, anhedonia (no longer climbing on weekends), and difficulty concentrating at work. Denies frank suicidal ideation but admits passive thoughts of "not waking up"; denies plan or intent. No prior psychiatric history or antidepressant trials. No history of mania, psychosis, or substance dependence. Drinks 4–6 units of alcohol per week, primarily weekends. Denies illicit drugs. Family history significant for maternal MDD treated with sertraline. Past medical history: hypothyroidism on levothyroxine 75 mcg daily. NKDA.
